CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PDP displays correct product name and designer/brand
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to a product detail page for a NAP or MRP product. Verify the product name and designer/brand name are displayed correctly and match the product.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The product name is displayed and is non-empty.
The designer/brand name is displayed as a single string and is correct for the product.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PDP displays the correct product price
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to a product detail page. Verify the price is displayed and matches the expected price for that product.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
A non-empty price is displayed on the PDP.
The price matches the expected value for the product.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PDP displays product sizes with stock availability
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to a product detail page that has multiple sizes. Verify all available sizes are listed and unavailable/out-of-stock sizes are clearly indicated.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
All expected sizes for the product are displayed.
Sizes that are out of stock are visually distinguished from available sizes.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PDP correctly reflects overall stock availability status
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to a product that is in stock and one that is out of stock. Verify the stock status is reflected correctly on each PDP.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
In-stock products allow size selection and add-to-bag action.
Out-of-stock products display an appropriate unavailability indicator.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PDP displays product images without broken image states
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to a product detail page. Verify that product images load correctly for at least two shot types (e.g. front-on and back).
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Product images load without broken image placeholders.
At least two image shot types are displayed (e.g. 'in' and 'ou' shots).

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Product images load from the expected image host domain
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inspect the image URLs on a NAP PDP and an MRP PDP. Verify the domain matches the expected host (www.net-a-porter.com for NAP, www.mrporter.com for MRP).
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
NAP product images are served from www.net-a-porter.com.
MRP product images are served from www.mrporter.com.
No images are served from unexpected or placeholder domains.
